lines.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods,
All the nations You have made
will come and bow before You, O Lord,
and they will glorify Your name.
For You are great and perform wonders;
Teach me Your way, O LORD,
that I may walk in Your truth.
that I may fear Your name.
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart;
I will glorify Your name forever.
For great is Your loving devotion to me;
You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

pictures.scene: Jacob Pynas, Paulus en Barnabas te Lystra door het volk als goden vereerd — the crowd bringing garlands to men who refuse them, because You answer me, O Lord there is none like You among the gods
pictures.name: pd_pynas_lystra

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, Landskapsmålning — the wide country lying under a rainbow after the rain, nor any works like Yours, all the nations You have made
pictures.name: pd_goyen_regenboog

pictures.scene: Pieter Bout, De aanbidding der herders — the shepherds kneeling in the straw before the child, will come and bow before You O Lord, and they will glorify Your name
pictures.name: pd_bout_herders

pictures.scene: Johan Edvard Bergh, Landscape with Waterfall from the Canton of Uri — the great fall pouring white out of the mountain wall, for You are great and perform wonders, You alone are God
pictures.name: pd_bergh_vattenfall

pictures.scene: Jan Brueghel the Elder, The Sermon on the Mount — the people seated on the hillside to be taught, teach me Your way O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_bergrede

pictures.scene: Albert Neuhuys, Interieur met strijkende vrouw en naaiend kind — the mother ironing and the child sewing, each at one task, give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name
pictures.name: pd_neuhuys_interieur

pictures.scene: Pieter Symonsz. Potter, Musicerend gezelschap in een interieur — the players gathered with lute and viol over one song, I will praise You O Lord my God with all my heart, I will glorify Your name forever
pictures.name: pd_potter_musicerend

pictures.scene: Eduard von Gebhardt, The Raising of Lazarus — the dead man called back out of the tomb into the light, for great is Your loving devotion to me, You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol
pictures.name: pd_gebhardt_lazarus
